analyst.summary: Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores had a record FY26 -- strong ore production growth, a jump in profit, and importantly the company became net debt-free by paying down its debentures. It has also been diversifying beyond pure mining into specialty steel through the Arjas Steel acquisition. But the sharp jump in revenue and profit reflects favorable ore prices as much as the company's own volume growth, and as a cyclical commodity business, that pace should not be assumed to continue. We rate it a Hold: a well-run, now genuinely deleveraged miner, but one still exposed to the ore-price cycle.
